root_cause.text: In `rto_next_cpu()`, the selection loop does not skip the currently executing CPU, so when it is the only overloaded CPU, it can pick itself, leading to a self-IPI that triggers an infinite loop and CPU hardlockup.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "Fix redundant self-IPI by filtering the initiating CPU in rto_next_cpu()", and the patch adds `if (cpu == this_cpu) continue;` to skip the current CPU during the loop.
